sources.supported_claim: Reliable accounts, planning, rapport and PEACE provide an alternative to coercive-interrogation clichés.
sources.claim_limit: England/Wales practice; queried URL without highlight failed to fetch, indexed highlighted page was accessible.

sources.title: College of Policing — Working with victims and witnesses
sources.supported_claim: Witness needs, respectful listening and interview preparation matter.
sources.claim_limit: Eye-level staging is our option; it does not prove trust, truthful testimony or victim status.

sources.title: 국립과학수사연구원 — 검시과
sources.supported_claim: 검안·부검을 통한 사인/사망 종류 조사와 치과·인류학적 개인식별 업무를 구분.
sources.claim_limit: 기관 업무 소개이며 특정 손상·사후시간·교흔의 신뢰성을 일괄 인증하지 않음.

sources.title: NIST — DNA Mixtures: A Forensic Science Explainer
sources.supported_claim: Contributor count, quantity, degradation and transfer complicate interpretation; source attribution differs from event reconstruction.
sources.claim_limit: Illustrative profiles are simplified; a plotted match cannot prove the criminal act.

sources.title: NISTIR 8387 — Digital Evidence Preservation
sources.supported_claim: Preservation and integrity checking are specific digital-evidence tasks.
sources.claim_limit: Hash agreement concerns the compared bytes, not the truth of depicted events; interface geometry is authored.

sources.title: NIST — Digital and Multimedia Evidence
sources.supported_claim: Digital evidence spans stored data, images, video and audio and requires validated methods.
sources.claim_limit: No unlimited recovery/enhancement claim; a monitor is not evidence of successful analysis.

sources.title: FATF — Guidance on Beneficial Ownership of Legal Persons
sources.supported_claim: Nominal company ownership and ultimate ownership/control should be distinguished.
sources.claim_limit: A company graph or shell company alone does not establish money laundering.

sources.title: OJP — Modus Operandi, Signature, and Staging
sources.supported_claim: 1992 abstract distinguishes learned MO, signature interpretation and deliberate scene alteration.
sources.claim_limit: Historical training account, not a validated personality detector; no universal invariance rule adopted.

sources.title: FBI — Serial Murder: Pathways for Investigations
sources.supported_claim: Investigative study of serial murder and heterogeneous offender/crime patterns.
sources.claim_limit: Selected PDF text only; does not authorize personality, motive or linkage inference from one staged object.

sources.title: US DOJ OVW — Sexual Assault
sources.supported_claim: Nonconsensual sexual acts and incapacity are central; a medical forensic exam is distinct from assault itself.
sources.claim_limit: US overview, not a substitute for Korean legal elements or proof from clothing/injury.

sources.title: eSafety Commissioner — Image-based abuse
sources.supported_claim: Nonconsensual sharing/threats and sextortion are related but distinguishable; revenge is not a necessary motive.
sources.claim_limit: Australian public guidance; a screen claim needs separate event, permission and authenticity context.

sources.title: UNODC — Crime of Trafficking in Persons
sources.supported_claim: Act, prohibited means and exploitation are distinguishable; adult/child requirements differ.
sources.claim_limit: International concept; national legal definitions and exceptions need a chosen jurisdiction.
sources.access_level: search-indexed primary excerpt; direct open returned 404; no full-page verification

sources.title: US DOJ OVW — Domestic Violence
sources.supported_claim: A pattern of power/control can involve physical, sexual, psychological, economic and technological abuse.
sources.claim_limit: Public overview; bruises, phones or a couple pose cannot establish the entire pattern.

sources.title: NIJ — Stab Resistance of Personal Body Armor
sources.supported_claim: Stab resistance and ballistic resistance address different threats.
sources.claim_limit: Testing scope, not a visual method for reading a vest performance level.

sources.title: V&A — The Burberry Trench: Crafting an Icon, large print guide
sources.supported_claim: Historical and contemporary trench forms retain and vary features including epaulettes and flaps.
sources.claim_limit: Brand-specific examples; neither gabardine nor a detective profession is proven by a silhouette.

sources.title: The Met — Schiaparelli Evening gloves, 1935–40
sources.supported_claim: A collection object documents evening-glove fashion and a particular designer treatment.
sources.claim_limit: Does not define all opera-glove lengths, materials or noir character functions.

sources.title: NIJ — The CSI Effect: Does It Really Exist?
sources.supported_claim: Evidence expectations and effects on verdicts are different empirical questions.
sources.claim_limit: Archived 2008 study discussion; not a claim about all present-day jurors.

sources.title: Forensic luminol interferences study — PubMed abstract
sources.supported_claim: Experimental interference can resemble luminol response, limiting standalone identification.
sources.claim_limit: Abstract only; no reagent recipe, operational sensitivity or universal reaction color certified.
sources.access_level: primary-study abstract in search excerpt; direct open returned only site footer

sources.title: UNODC — Forensic analysis of drugs facilitating sexual assault
sources.supported_claim: Technical guidance separates toxicological evidence collection/analysis from the legal act and consent question.
sources.claim_limit: Search-indexed PDF metadata/excerpts, not full review; specific detection windows and sampling claims deferred.
sources.access_level: search-indexed PDF excerpt/metadata; full PDF not reviewed

sources.title: OHCHR — Istanbul Protocol, 2022 catalog record
sources.supported_claim: Manual concerns effective investigation/documentation of torture and ill-treatment.
sources.claim_limit: Catalog record verified; detailed lesion interpretation or absence-of-injury propositions not independently reviewed here.
sources.access_level: OHCHR catalog/search record only; manual body not reviewed

sources.title: FBI — Trafficking Indicators
sources.supported_claim: Exploitation can occur without smuggling or crossing borders; records/control may be investigative material.
sources.claim_limit: Indicators are not standalone proof or an image-based classification rule.
